title: Nvidia halved its $250bn promise to OpenAI. Then it showed investors what it owns
summary: Nvidia and OpenAI announced an agreement last September covering at least 10GW, with Nvidia investing up to $100bn. The headline number is SpaceX, at 122.8 million Class A shares worth roughly $21bn, which makes it Nvidia’s second-largest position.
